release_name: The help button for stuck updates opened the search tips
notes: Update help. Two changes, both found by asking whether the help section still matched the app after v27.6.24. (1) The update banner's 'Having trouble updating?' button asked openMoreSection for a section named 'updateHelp'. There is no such section - moreSectionContent() knows help/install/about/update/report and ends in ||sections.help - so the one button offered to a user whose update was stuck opened the SEARCH TIPS, with no tab highlighted and neither 'Check for update' nor the Repair link on screen. Confirmed in the running app, not just read. It now opens 'How to update'. A correct openUpdateHelp() had existed all along and was never called; it has been removed, since two ways to do one thing is how the bug survived. New gate G14 checks every more-panel section key that is asked for actually exists, because a silent ||fallback is invisible otherwise. (2) The help copy never mentioned the two messages added in v27.6.24. It now explains that 'Still downloading the update' means wait and do NOT tap Repair yet - the exact mistake the old 6s message used to invite - and that 'The update could not be downloaded' means it failed while the app still works. EN and FR, byte-level edit, parity checked. No data change: 426 rows.
